verdict.rationale: Clipboard history is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack documents a clipboard history, let alone one covering text and images behind a single hotkey. Universal Clipboard only copies and pastes a single item across nearby devices, and pbcopy/pbpaste are command-line access to the current clipboard; both are adjacent features, not a history.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can access a unified clipboard history across text and images with one hotkey
